script.title: THE PIANO STAIRS
script.title_quote: Three flights add a small fee
script.story_hook: A piano, three flights, and one honest quote.
script.intro_zh: 一架鋼琴、三層樓梯,和一張誠實清楚的搬家報價單。
script.welcome_en: Hi! Today: getting an honest moving quote.
script.welcome_zh: 你好!今天來學怎麼問搬家報價。
script.outro: Sixty lines — that's a booked move. Have a lovely day!
script.outro_zh: 六十句聽完,搬家也就約好了。祝你一天愉快!
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat after me, line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我,一句一句唸。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her twenties with shoulder-length black hair in a low ponytail, wearing a mustard-yellow sweater, blue jeans and white sneakers, slim build, holding a crumpled floor-plan paper
script.char_b_description: a heavyset middle-aged man with a shaved head and short gray beard, wearing a navy work jacket over a red plaid shirt, khaki cargo pants and steel-toe boots, thick arms, friendly squinting eyes

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like a quote for a move.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk ə kwaʊt fər ə muv/
dialogue.zh: 你好,我想請你們報個搬家的價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. When are you moving?
dialogue.zh: 好啊。你們什麼時候搬?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: June third, across town.
dialogue.zh: 六月三號,搬到城裡另一頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool. Big place or small?
dialogue.zh: 好。地方大還是小?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A two-bedroom apartment, third floor.
dialogue.zh: 兩房公寓,在三樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any elevator in that building?
dialogue.zh: 那棟大樓有電梯嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope, just stairs. Sorry!
dialogue.zh: 沒有,只有樓梯,不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three flights add a small fee.
dialogue.zh: 三層樓梯會加一點費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How small? Just curious.
dialogue.zh: 加多少?我好奇問一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty dollars for the stairs.
dialogue.zh: 樓梯的部分二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that's actually fair enough.
dialogue.zh: 好吧,這其實挺公道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We take it slow and careful.
dialogue.zh: 我們搬得又慢又小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, um, one big thing…
dialogue.zh: 那個,呃,還有一件大事……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead — no surprises, please.
dialogue.zh: 你說——先講好,可別有意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have an upright piano.
dialogue.zh: 我們有一台直式鋼琴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it — piano to the new place?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt piˈænoʊ tə ðə nu pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 了解——鋼琴也一併搬到新家?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. It was my grandmother's.
dialogue.zh: 對,那是我外婆留下的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we treat it like glass.
dialogue.zh: 那我們會像搬玻璃一樣照顧它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a piano fee too?
dialogue.zh: 鋼琴也要另外收費嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred flat, crew and gear.
dialogue.zh: 一百塊封頂,含人力和器材。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ouch. But worth it, I guess.
dialogue.zh: 哎喲。但我想還是值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth it. What about the couch?
dialogue.zh: 值得的。那沙發呢?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Couch, bed, boxes — normal stuff.
dialogue.zh: 沙發、床、紙箱,都是普通東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That fits our big truck easily.
dialogue.zh: 那些我們的大卡車輕輕鬆鬆裝得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you bring the moving boxes?
dialogue.zh: 你們會附紙箱嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We rent boxes — fifteen cents each.
dialogue.zh: 我們出租紙箱,一個十五分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheap! Or can I buy them?
dialogue.zh: 好便宜!還是也可以直接買下?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy or rent — your call.
dialogue.zh: 買或租,都由你決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many boxes does my place need?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɑkəz dʌz maɪ pleɪs nid/
dialogue.zh: 我那裡需要幾個紙箱?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bedrooms? Around thirty, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 兩間臥室的話,大概三十個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty boxes… my hallway's tiny.
dialogue.zh: 三十個紙箱……我的走廊很小啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stack them flat under the bed.
dialogue.zh: 把它們壓平,塞在床底下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart. So, total for the move?
dialogue.zh: 聰明。那,搬家總價多少?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Base is six eighty, plus extras.
dialogue.zh: 基本價六百八,再加上其他費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six eighty — that's with stairs?
dialogue.zh: 六百八——這樣含樓梯費了嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stairs and piano make it seven-eighty.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛrz ænd piˈænoʊ meɪk ɪt ˈsɛvən ˈæti/
dialogue.zh: 加上樓梯和鋼琴,變成七百八。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa. Can two people really handle that?
dialogue.phonetic: /woʊ kæn tu ˈpipəl ˈrɪli ˈhændl ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 哇。兩個人真的搬得動嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Piano days mean a four-person crew.
dialogue.phonetic: /piˈænoʊ deɪz min ə fɔr ˈpɜrsən kru/
dialogue.zh: 搬鋼琴的日子,我們會來四個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better. Um, when do I pay?
dialogue.zh: 這樣好多了。呃,我什麼時候付錢?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half today, half on moving day.
dialogue.zh: 今天付一半,搬家當天再付一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card or cash?
dialogue.zh: 刷卡還是現金?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either works. We text receipts too.
dialogue.zh: 都可以。我們也會用簡訊發收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… one last worry: parking.
dialogue.zh: 好……我最後擔心的是停車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The truck needs a parking permit.
dialogue.zh: 卡車需要一張停車許可證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Permit? From the city or building?
dialogue.zh: 許可證?要跟市府還是大樓申請?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The building office — they're slow.
dialogue.zh: 找大樓管理室——不過他們很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, June third is soon…
dialogue.zh: 噢,六月三號眼看就要到了……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll call them today. Don't worry.
dialogue.zh: 我今天會打電話給他們。別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'd really do that for me?
dialogue.zh: 你們真的會幫我處理嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We handle permits all the time.
dialogue.zh: 這種許可證我們常常辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, you just earned my trust.
dialogue.zh: 好,你們贏得我的信任了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. I'll write up your quote.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我現在來寫你的報價單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the price change after today?
dialogue.zh: 今天之後價格還會變動嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not unless you add more furniture.
dialogue.zh: 除非你再加家具,就不會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Book me in, please!
dialogue.zh: 太好了。請幫我把行程報上!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven eighty total. Deal?
dialogue.zh: 總共七百八。成交?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal! Where do I sign?
dialogue.zh: 成交!我要在哪裡簽名?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here — name, phone, date.
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡——姓名、電話、日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! Four people, June third, yes!
dialogue.zh: 簽好了!四個人、六月三號,太棒了!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're set. See you, June three!
dialogue.zh: 都搞定了。六月三號見!
